body.summary: OPENCODE_BASE_URL is unset — OpenCode is not configured, so nothing was dispatched.

interpretation: The adapter and its orchestrator backend are real and registered; the engine itself is not configured in this environment. OPENCODE_BASE_URL unset is reported as NOT_CONFIGURED, and no task is dispatched or silently redirected to the local runtime. The dispatch path (POST /session then POST /session/{id}/message) is implemented and stub-tested, but has not been exercised against a live OpenCode server.
